name: App lock (fingerprint/face or PIN)
description: Second-step unlock any app can put after its own first step: strong biometrics through BiometricPrompt, or a 4–12 digit PIN kept only as a salted PBKDF2 hash in the Keystore-backed secure store. Failed PINs lock out with a doubling delay. Settings group App lock (mode, auto-lock delay) and a set/change PIN screen (current PIN required to change). Fills the platform's android.biometric placeholder.

placeholders.note: Keystore keys that need the fingerprint for every decrypt (CryptoObject). Not built: the lock gates the UI; data keys don't require auth yet.
